label: No placebo
rationale: This record describes an open-label extension with a single group, and the extension arm states that all participants receive active drug. The placebo-controlled part is the earlier parent trial, not this extension, so the current study design itself does not include a placebo comparator.

evidence.quote: all participants will be on active drug

title: An Open-Label Extension for the Phase 2 Study in Early Symptomatic Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Patients on Stable Background Therapy to Assess Bioenergetic Catalysis With CNM-Au8 to Slow Disease Progression in ALS
